title: update_object
summary: Benilla's SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT decode: the five update kinds, the movement block (LIVING pose + 6 speeds, rider TransportPose, create-time in-progress CreateSpline with the phantom-endpoint trim, transport GO path progress) and the sparse ObjectFields descriptor accessors. MSUI's UpdateObjectParser + ObjectFields port the framing and field decode faithfully (incl. compressed form and created-mask absent=0 semantics), but the movement block only surfaces position/orientation/speeds - the three richer payloads are parsed for alignment and thrown away.

openItems.text: Create-time live spline (MOVEFLAG_SPLINE_ENABLED tail) is read and discarded - a creature already mid-walk when it streams into view stands frozen at its create pose until the next SMSG_MONSTER_MOVE (the exact bug Benilla decision 0708 fixed), and the spline id/time_passed/duration/flying/cyclic never reach the entity layer
Rider TransportPose (MOVEFLAG_ON_TRANSPORT tail in the LIVING block) is discarded - an observed unit standing on a boat/zeppelin/elevator cannot be re-anchored through the transport frame
UPDATE_FLAG_TRANSPORT path-progress u32 is discarded - the transport GameObject cycle anchor (Benilla decision 0438) is unavailable to any elevator/ship evaluator
